user.title: Frieda Postfach
user.description: Inbox rules, push delivery and the daily overview for a Frieda account. Frieda Postfach uses the account's connection; no second password is needed. Existing rules of the account are picked up automatically.

abort.no_frieda: Set up the Frieda integration (friedafetch 2.0 or newer) first.
abort.already_configured: Frieda Postfach is already set up for every Frieda account.

menu_options.foryou: For you: important senders, calendar, replies, weekly review

automation.title: Frieda Postfach
automation.description: Daily overview: a short morning summary of unread e-mails, rule activity, today's events and birthdays.

data_description.rules_auto: To new e-mails in the inbox.
data_description.rules_push: Apply the rules right after new mail arrives.
data_description.digest_notify: Notify service; empty = notification in Home Assistant.

ai.title: AI sorting
ai.description: Off unless you switch it on here AND choose an AI entity. New inbox mail that no rule handled is then rated by that AI: one of your categories, importance 1–5 and a short reason. The AI receives sender, recipients and subject, plus the first 1,000 characters of the text only if you allow it below. With a cloud AI this data leaves Home Assistant. The AI cannot delete or send anything. Start with "Only rate" and check the ratings in the panel before letting it act.

data.ai_known_senders: Sort known senders without the AI

data_description.ai_entity: An AI Task entity, e.g. from Google Generative AI, OpenAI or a local Ollama model.
data_description.ai_exclude: Never sent to an AI, one per line. For example your bank, doctor or employer: bank.example, doctor@example.com
data_description.ai_block_terms: Mail containing these terms is never sent to an AI, one per line. Checked locally in subject, sender and text before anything is sent, also for the AI daily overview. Example: diagnosis, salary, password
data_description.ai_include_body: The first 1,000 characters of the text.
data_description.ai_known_senders: When the AI sorted a sender's mail the same way three times in a row and was sure, Frieda sorts that sender's next mail itself – nothing is sent, the hourly limit is not used. Every tenth time the AI looks again; a correction makes the AI look again at once.

foryou.title: For you
foryou.description: What Frieda notices for you. Everything is worked out in Home Assistant from your mailbox and contacts; nothing of it goes to an AI. Dates from e-mails need the AI sorting: the AI names a date it reads in a mail it rates anyway, and you add it to the calendar with one click.

data.events_calendar: Calendar for entries from the notification

data_description.vip_groups: Mail from these people is never lost among the rest: the AI rates it as important, and it is announced also without the AI.
data_description.vip_senders: One per line, e.g. anna@example.com or example.com.
data_description.vip_notify: With the notification service of the daily overview.
data_description.ai_events: Appointments and deadlines the AI reads in a mail it rates. Nothing is entered without your click.
data_description.events_calendar: Empty = the first calendar Frieda may write to. In the panel you choose each time.
data_description.followup_days: Mail you sent to people that got no answer after this many days. 0 = off.
data_description.weekly_day: At the time of the daily overview, else at 18:00.

error.invalid_time: Please enter a time as HH:MM, e.g. 07:30.
error.ai_entity_required: Choose an AI entity, or switch AI sorting off.
error.ai_entity_invalid: This AI entity does not exist (any more).

send_digest.name: Send daily overview
send_digest.description: Sends the daily overview (unread e-mails, rule activity, today's events, birthdays) now.

account.name: Account
account.description: Label or Apple ID of the account (default: all accounts).

options.act: Run the category actions (move, mark read, flag)

frieda_too_old.title: Frieda is too old for Frieda Postfach
frieda_too_old.description: Frieda Postfach needs Frieda {required} or newer; installed is {installed}. Update Frieda in HACS and restart Home Assistant. Until then the panel shows its parts one below the other and some of them are missing.
